name: Glass AI meeting summary
oneLiner: an AI meeting summary card on glass: a light runs round the rim while decisions and action items write themselves in word by word, each task gets its owner chip, then one task box fills green, the tick draws and the line strikes through
say: when the speaker says the AI took the notes or wrote the recap ('it summarised the whole call', 'and it gave everyone their tasks'): decisions and tasks write in as they talk, the green tick lands on 'done' or 'already sent'
